mechanism_narrative: High CPIAUCSL (above 210) signals persistent inflation, increasing real interest rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 210, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated FEDFUNDS (above 4.5%) indicates active monetary tightening, raising discount rates and reducing equity cash flow present values, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) and housing starts (HOUST < 1250) signals a weak labor market and faltering consumer demand, triggering negative equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, GDPC1 exceeding 16000 signals overextended economic growth, prompting profit-taking and negative equity returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 > 16000 during late-cycle regimes.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO falling below 105 indicates weakening industrial output, signaling recessionary pressures that reduce corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 105.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST below 1250 reflects declining residential construction, indicating weak consumer demand and reduced economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1250.

mechanism_narrative: Strong PAYEMS growth (above 138000) indicates robust labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 138000.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS below 370000 signals weak residential investment, indicating slowing economic momentum and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS < 370000.
